messages:
Ava: Huge thanks everyone — that all-hands was electric. Coffee on me at HQ after lunch :coffee:
Sam: :clap: Amazing talk, loved the roadmap bits (and the dog cameo)
Jen: Someone took the bagels? calling out the bagel bandit :eyes:
Raj: Not me, but I will accept any leftover croissants as evidence of gratitude :croissant: :sunglasses:
Maria: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/dance-ferret — mandatory celebratory ferret
OpsBot: Quick informal poll — what are you grabbing for the 2pm snack? React with an emoji: :coffee: coffee, :tea: tea, :croissant: pastry, :pretzel: savory
Ellie: casting my vote :croissant:
Tomas: propose a 10-min virtual paper-airplane contest to settle snack disputes :airplane:
Ava: I love this. Rules: paper only, one try each, distance wins. Winner gets a mystery snack box :trophy:
Sam: on it. folding skills activated 
Jen: /me is already practicing my aerodynamic folds :nerd_face:
Raj: happy to be judge, but bribes accepted (jk) :money_with_wings:
Maria: also huge shoutout to infra for the smooth demo — real MVPs :clap::clap::clap:
Ava: yes — infra team, 100% kudos. Tagging you all in the follow-up thread for a proper thank-you note
OpsBot: Recording and slides uploaded to #resources/recordings — link pinned
Ellie: who wants to meet in the lounge at 2:55 for final plane assembly? :handshake:
Tomas: i'll livestream my attempt, camera angle very important :camera_with_flash:
Sam: bringing snacks if anyone wants to bet on distance :popcorn:
Jen: ok but first — group selfie at the end? virtual background: confetti mandatory :camera_with_flash::confetti_ball:
Maria: could we have a tiny applause gif chain after? starting now: :clap: :clap: :clap:
Ava: best all-hands energy. see y'all at the lounge :)
